"""One bounded evidence-discovery batch; raw Parallel results, no model judgement."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
from greenlight.tools.toolbelt import _live_extract, _live_search

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--source", type=Path)
parser.add_argument("--url", action="append", default=[])
args = parser.parse_args()
if args.output.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Refusing to overwrite saved results")
jobs = [
    {"id": "jaws_clip", "objective": "Find primary evidence identifying the current clip licensing administrator for JAWS (1975), with an exact film-title entry and evidence that the party licenses clips. Distinguish distribution credits from licensing authority; a generic studio catalog alone does not prove the film is represented.",
     "queries": ["JAWS 1975 clip licensing rights", "JAWS Universal media licensing catalog"]},
    {"id": "hallelujah_master", "objective": "Find primary evidence linking Jeff Buckley's original Hallelujah recording on Grace (1994) to its current master recording owner or licensing administrator. Distinguish composition/publishing rights, distributor or retail credits, corporate affiliation and actual master licensing authority. Return explicit recording/version and party evidence, not an inferred owner.",
     "queries": ["Jeff Buckley Hallelujah master licensing", "Jeff Buckley Grace Sony sync licensing"]},
]
record = {"created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "runtime_wrapper_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "src/greenlight/tools/toolbelt.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "execution_script": Path(__file__).read_text(), "kind": "extract" if args.source else "search", "calls": []}
if args.source:
    source_bytes = args.source.read_bytes()
    source = json.loads(source_bytes)
    allowed = {r["url"] for c in source["calls"] for r in c.get("response", {}).get("results", [])}
    if not 1 <= len(args.url) <= 2 or any(url not in allowed for url in args.url):
        raise SystemExit("Extract requires 1-2 URLs from the saved search")
    record.update(source_path=str(args.source), source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest())
    jobs = [{"id": f"extract_{i}", "url": url, "objective": "Return verbatim evidence of exact work/version, the named rights party and its licensing role for JAWS (1975) clip licensing or Jeff Buckley's Hallelujah master recording. Include limitations, exclusions, contact instructions and any missing ownership link; do not infer rights from distribution or corporate affiliation."} for i, url in enumerate(args.url)]
elif args.url:
    raise SystemExit("URLs require a saved source")
for job in jobs:
    call = {"request": job, "started_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "status": "running"}
    record["calls"].append(call)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        call["response"] = (_live_extract([job["url"]], job["objective"]) if args.source else _live_search(job["objective"], job["queries"]))
        call["status"] = "returned"
    except Exception as exc:
        call["status"] = "error"
        call["error_type"] = type(exc).__name__
    finally:
        call["elapsed_s"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 2)
        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
        print(job["id"], call["status"], call["elapsed_s"], flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(c["status"] == "returned" for c in record["calls"]) else 1)
